TextBlock.Text: THEATRE Eastern Banda Sea
DATE 19 November 2028 · 1030 local
SIDE People's Liberation Army Navy
WINDOW 75 min, closes at 112
Type 054A frigate. Photo: U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist 1st Class Scott Ta... · Public domain · cropped

EASTERN BANDA SEA, 1030. The coalition's next convoy is forming west of the Kai Islands with a Japanese escort detachment, and it sails tomorrow. Headquarters wants names: which merchant matters, and which escorts hunt submarines.

DRAGON EYE 05, a KJ-500, has the long look from the north-west, and a J-15 pair keeps it company; a patrol aircraft from the enclave field can share the look if one is allocated. Your frigate shadows from outside the escorts' reach and closes only as far as a classification needs. Two Australian F-35s are covering the convoy at weapons Tight, and a RAAF Growler flies with them, listening. If they fire, you may reply against the aircraft that fired and nothing else - by direct order: fighters left free will find the Growler, which never fires, and that ends the operation. A USAF RC-135 Rivet Joint out of Tindal holds a track south of the box at thirty-one thousand feet with every radar in it on its screens, DRAGON EYE's included; it carries nothing, and it is not a target either. Nothing in that convoy or its escort is a target.
The picture you build goes to headquarters. What is done with it tomorrow will be done by people this group does not command.
A Kai fishing boat, a stern trawler and the Tual-Ambon ferry are in the box, and the Sydney-Hong Kong service crosses it at altitude.
Fleet headquarters
COMMANDER'S INTENT

Headquarters needs to know which merchant matters and which escorts hunt, by class and by name, before the convoy sails. Get the names and bring the aircraft home. The convoy and its escort are not targets today, and the group does not start a fight with their fighters. If they fire, reply against the aircraft that fired.
• Classify MV Coral Pioneer and both Japanese escorts, then take the frigate back north-west
• Fire on nothing in the convoy or its escort, nor on the Growler or the Rivet Joint
• Bring Dragon Eye 05 home
• Classify the covering fighters
• Harm no fishing boat, ferry or airliner

Your screen with its flight, and a J-15 pair and a patrol aircraft if allocated. Allocated: Dragon Eye 05, a KJ-500. Opposing: three merchants, JS Mogami and JS Maya, two RAAF F-35As at weapons Tight, a RAAF EA-18G Growler at weapons Hold and a USAF RC-135 Rivet Joint at weapons Hold south of the box. Neutral: two Kai fishing hulls, a ferry and an airliner. The enclave field, 400 miles north-east, is where the aircraft recover.

The planned window is 75 minutes. At that minute Command signals that you are behind schedule and holds the line for about 37 minutes more; the operation is closed at 112 minutes and the main task will be recorded as failed.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT
All designated neutral contacts are protected. A protected neutral loss cancels the operation. Identify before you shoot.
